anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy apply in the report view?
A) Clear all active filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace's last-used filters when switching back to it.
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already retains active filters, so B keeps current behavior and needs no new state. C would require a per-workspace filter store outside settings/resolver.ts, which owns only defaults.

Recommendation: C - preserves each workspace’s context without carrying unrelated filters into another workspace.
